native_dependency.status: Retain compatible native collapse/reference hierarchy and owners. No operating rotor, grinding clip, new rig or playback is established or supplied.

A1.native_stamp_status: Exact retained static transform; apply once after source fit. Bone/reference projection remains a separate gate.

quern.motion: Static hand-quern function cue only; no new or inherited rotation clip claimed

triangle_cap_scope: Generated source geometry only; complete visible dependency count remains an acceptance requirement.
native_gates: Deferred: native export/cook, bindings, placement, owner rendering, mechanisms/animation, lifecycle transitions, destruction/repair, import and multiplayer.
